opening.argument: The video presents Forsage as a business opportunity built around a matrix strategy, directs viewers toward registration, and describes positions funded through partner recruitment. It states that partners occupy positions below the participant and that the resulting fee is credited to the participant's wallet. The presentation also promotes paying 0.05 ETH plus additional fees, beginning with multiple positions, and projecting 1430 ETH within 12 weeks through X3 and X4 return tables. These are payment and return claims supporting the promoted opportunity, while the available evidence does not establish that the figures were achieved, transactions occurred, or returns were guaranteed.

citations.quote: Forced marketing has a matrix strategy
Usually, when you invite your partners, they will take the positions below you.
When the first partner occupies the first spot under you, 100% of the fee will be credited into your personal wallet.
